NUS Highlights

Learn how our transformative education and multidisciplinary research have nurtured effective global leaders, impacted society and transformed lives for the better.


  • Featured

  • News

NUS Achievement Awards 2026 celebrates student excellence beyond the classroom

The NUS Achievement Awards (NAA) 2026 celebrated 341 students and graduates from the Class of 2026 for their outstanding achievements beyond the classroom, reflecting the diverse ways students have made a difference to campus life and the wider community.

News, Student Life

From climate change to criminal justice, NUS is training graduates to think across discipline

Newly launched by the Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences, the Second Major in Environmental Science for Sustainability and the Minor in Criminal Justice equip students with interdisciplinary skills to address complex real-world challenges.

General, Community, Education

The Southeast Asia young people want to see

At the inaugural ASEAN Symposium for Youth Leaders, 91 young leaders from all 11 ASEAN countries came together to imagine new possibilities for the region, from creating blue economies to green education hubs. The participants, comprising undergraduate and postgraduate university students, were selected based on their interest in governance, public policy and international affairs.

Highlights

In memoriam: Professor Leong Ching, pioneering scholar and passionate student advocate

Professor Leong Ching, NUS Vice Provost of Student Life, an institutional economist and leading scholar in behavioural public policy, passed away on 6 November 2026.

An NUS alumna (Arts & Social Sciences '92, MA '96, Public Policy PhD '13), she was the NUSS Professor in Behavioural Public Policy at the Lee Kuan Yew School of Public Policy (LKYSPP).

News, Highlights

President's Welcome

We are Singapore’s flagship university. We hope you will be inspired by the many fascinating facets that make NUS a leading global university centred in Asia.

Shaping the Future

"At NUS, we are moving boldly — and concertedly — to expand tomorrow's frontiers. We believe that we have the power to shape the future, for the better."


Learn more

NUS Now

Come discover our exciting and vibrant campus and find out why #NUSLife is invigorating and fulfilling.

 
 
 
 
 

Thought Leadership

Distinguished thought leaders, movers and shakers in Singapore and across the globe gather regularly on campus to share their insights and engage in intellectual discourse.

Why Singapore can’t afford a hazy October each year

The Republic’s selling point is reliability. The cost can be enormous if every dry season carries the risk of bad air.


Learn more

S-E Asia’s haze shows a diversified electricity source may not be that dependable

As countries grow reliant on power from across borders, how much will be available when several need it at once?


Learn more
